title: Jo. Waddall (London) to 'Vanyeare' at Bruges, 22 Aug 1656 (Thurloe State Papers v.337)

steps.what: Extracted piece (d) from Birch's Thurloe State Papers on British History Online.

Applied every 1653-60 royalist and Commonwealth key from cryptiana (Marshall, Barwick-Hyde, Stamford, Butler, Charles II intercepted 1655, Kingston, Westrope, Hague agent/Blake) to piece (d) with apply_keys.py, scored by quadgram models: nothing readable.
(d) cribs like 'horse' and 'hang' in the rich clear frame fit many assignments equally well.

Split under the one-key rule from thurloe (four unrelated pieces of the Thurloe State Papers): piece (d) gets its own entry; ciphertext file moved here (apply_keys.py and solve_a2.py in targets/thurloe/ now read it from this folder).

outcome.method_basis: Fifty groups over 29 homophonic symbols that no 1653-60 key on cryptiana reads; cribs from the clear frame fit many assignments equally well.
outcome.notes: Original in Bodleian Rawlinson A vol. xli, not digitised; Birch's print is the only witness; the key would be among the Bruges court's agents' ciphers (Clarendon MSS), not online. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from thurloe.

gaps.detail: 29 distinct homophonic symbols in 50 groups; key in the Clarendon MSS, not online.

credits.note: Thurloe State Papers (1742): the only witness of the four intercepts

prior.where: Listed as undeciphered by Tomokiyo (cryptiana item #9); Birch's transcriptions are the only online witness and carry no decipherment.
